strings.name: Ricky Martin
strings.summary: Martin moved from Menudo to Spanish-language solo records and then English-language pop with Livin’ la Vida Loca. Dance, Latin rhythms and cross-language performance shape his work, alongside musical theater and television. Through his foundation and UNICEF, he advocates for child protection, education and opposition to human trafficking.

strings.influence.rationale: His Spanish- and English-language pop travels across borders, alongside sustained child-protection and anti-trafficking advocacy.

strings.facts.f1.value: Born in San Juan, Puerto Rico, in 1971.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Cross-language pop

strings.highlights.h2.title: Protecting children
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supports children’s rights and anti-trafficking efforts through his foundation and UNICEF.
